about: Security findings for startups.promptugal.news: every vulnerability, bug and breach, ours included, published at Dinis's word (18 November 2026, PrompTugal__News__Website board/guidance/2026-11-18-security-findings-published.md). A fixed finding is published in full; an open one only as its title, severity and state until it is fixed. Kept by startups.b@PrompTugal.dinis; read by scripts/generate.mjs for /security/.

findings.title: Link schemes not checked: a javascript: or data: URL in a research file could have become a link
findings.found_by: startups.b@PrompTugal.dinis, an AppSec check after conductor.b@'s heads-up about the same class of bug on events.promptugal.news and data.promptugal.news
findings.detail: Every value was HTML-escaped, but an entry's url or source_url was not checked for its scheme before it became an href. A research file holding a javascript: or data: URL would have produced a link that ran script when clicked; only the validator's local-link check would have stopped the build, by accident. No such URL was found in the data.
findings.fix: safeUrl() at merge: only absolute http(s) URLs become links; anything else is dropped and counted; URLs with spaces or quotes are percent-encoded.
